# cachefly_edge_control_library_scripts (Data Source)

Lists the edge control script library: `SYSTEM` scripts curated by CacheFly and the account's own `USER` scripts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All request scripts curated by CacheFly
data "cachefly_edge_control_library_scripts" "system_request" {
  type = "SYSTEM"
  kind = "REQUEST"
}

output "system_request_scripts" {
  value = { for s in data.cachefly_edge_control_library_scripts.system_request.scripts : s.name => s.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `kind` (String) Only return scripts of this kind: `REQUEST` or `RESPONSE`.
- `limit` (Number) Number of scripts fetched per request while reading all pages (default: 100, max: 1000).
- `offset` (Number) Number of scripts to skip (default: 0).
- `search` (String) Only return scripts whose name matches this text (at least 2 characters).
- `type` (String) Only return scripts of this ownership type: `USER` or `SYSTEM`.

### Read-Only

- `scripts` (Attributes List) Library scripts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scripts))

<a id="nestedatt--scripts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scripts`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) JavaScript source of the script.
- `created_at` (String) When the library script was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the library script.
- `kind` (String) Kind of script (REQUEST or RESPONSE).
- `name` (String) Name of the library script.
- `type` (String) Ownership type of the script (USER or SYSTEM).
- `updated_at` (String) When the library script was last updated.
